name.en-US: Letter on the Sandals of the Apostles
name.pt-BR: Carta sobre as sandálias dos Apóstolos

description.la: Epistola de sandaliis Apostolorum (opus dubium), de calceamento fratrum. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia VIII, 1898), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A letter on the sandals of the Apostles and the footwear of the friars (a work of doubtful authorship attributed to Bonaventure). The Latin is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia VIII, 1898) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Carta sobre as sandálias dos Apóstolos.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. VIII (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1898), pp. 386-390.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type scholia are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1898 is public domain.
